examples.en: Travel can broaden your mind and teach you about other cultures.
examples.zh: 旅行能開拓你的視野，讓你了解其他文化。

examples.en: The city plans to broaden the road to ease traffic.
examples.zh: 市政府打算拓寬這條道路，以改善塞車。

examples.en: She took a class to broaden her knowledge of art history.
examples.zh: 她修了一門課，以拓展自己的藝術史知識。

examples.en: The hotel gave us a brochure about local attractions.
examples.zh: 旅館給了我們一本介紹當地景點的小冊子。

examples.en: Please pick up a brochure at the front desk.
examples.zh: 請到櫃檯領取一本簡介手冊。

examples.en: The school sends a brochure to every new family.
examples.zh: 學校會寄一本簡介手冊給每個新家庭。

examples.en: Broil the fish for five minutes on each side.
examples.zh: 把魚的每一面各烤五分鐘。

examples.en: My father likes to broil chicken in the oven.
examples.zh: 我爸爸喜歡用烤箱烤雞肉。

examples.en: You can broil the vegetables instead of frying them.
examples.zh: 你可以炙烤蔬菜，而不是油炸。

examples.en: She cooked a bowl of hot chicken broth for her sick son.
examples.zh: 她為生病的兒子煮了一碗熱雞湯。

examples.en: Add some broth to the pot and let it simmer.
examples.zh: 在鍋裡加一些高湯，讓它慢慢燉煮。

examples.en: The noodle shop is famous for its rich beef broth.
examples.zh: 這家麵店以濃郁的牛肉湯頭聞名。

examples.en: The two players share a strong brotherhood.
examples.zh: 這兩位球員之間有深厚的兄弟情誼。

examples.en: The club promotes friendship and brotherhood among its members.
examples.zh: 這個社團促進成員之間的友誼與兄弟情誼。

examples.en: He joined a brotherhood of volunteer firefighters.
examples.zh: 他加入了一個義消互助團體。

examples.en: I left my bulky winter coat at home.
examples.zh: 我把笨重的冬季外套留在家裡。

examples.en: The bulky package would not fit through the door.
examples.zh: 那個體積龐大的包裹塞不進門裡。

examples.en: Bulky furniture makes a small room feel crowded.
examples.zh: 笨重的家具讓小房間顯得擁擠。

examples.en: The bureaucrat at the city office asked me to fill out another form.
examples.zh: 市公所的官員要我再填一份表格。

examples.en: Many people think a bureaucrat cares more about rules than people.
examples.zh: 許多人認為官僚比起人更在乎規定。

examples.en: My uncle works as a bureaucrat in the education department.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在教育局擔任行政官員。

examples.en: The new bypass will keep trucks out of the town center.
examples.zh: 新的繞道將讓卡車不再進入市中心。

examples.en: We took the bypass to avoid the heavy traffic.
examples.zh: 我們走繞道以避開壅塞的車流。

examples.en: The bypass around the village saves drivers ten minutes.
examples.zh: 繞過村莊的外環道為駕駛人省下十分鐘。

examples.en: You can bypass the line by ordering online.
examples.zh: 你可以線上訂購，避開排隊。

examples.en: The new route will bypass the busy downtown area.
examples.zh: 新路線將繞過繁忙的市中心。

examples.en: Some students try to bypass the rules, but that is unfair.
examples.zh: 有些學生想規避規定，但這樣不公平。

examples.en: Too much caffeine can keep you awake at night.
examples.zh: 攝取過多咖啡因會讓你晚上睡不著。

examples.en: This tea contains less caffeine than coffee.
examples.zh: 這種茶的咖啡因含量比咖啡少。

examples.en: Doctors advise teenagers to avoid caffeine in the evening.
examples.zh: 醫生建議青少年晚上避免攝取咖啡因。

examples.en: My grandfather practices calligraphy every morning.
examples.zh: 爺爺每天早上練習書法。

examples.en: The calligraphy on the scroll is beautiful.
examples.zh: 捲軸上的書法非常美。

examples.en: Chinese calligraphy is often displayed during the Lunar New Year.
examples.zh: 農曆新年期間常會展示書法作品。

examples.en: Take one capsule after each meal.
examples.zh: 每餐後服用一顆膠囊。

examples.en: She swallowed the capsule with a glass of water.
examples.zh: 她用一杯水吞下膠囊。

examples.en: The space capsule landed safely in the ocean.
examples.zh: 太空艙安全降落在海中。

senses.zh: 被囚禁的；被圈養的；無法脫身的

examples.en: The captive bird was released into the wild.
examples.zh: 被關住的鳥被放回野外。

examples.en: Captive animals need large spaces to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 圈養的動物需要寬敞的空間才能保持健康。

examples.en: The captive audience had to listen to the long speech.
examples.zh: 那些無法離場的聽眾只好聽完冗長的演講。

examples.en: The story tells of a princess who escaped from captivity.
examples.zh: 故事描述一位公主逃離囚禁。

examples.en: The zoo helps endangered birds breed in captivity.
examples.zh: 動物園協助瀕危鳥類在圈養環境下繁殖。

examples.en: The writer described his months in captivity in a new book.
examples.zh: 作家在新書裡描述了他被囚禁的那幾個月。

examples.en: We made a model house out of cardboard.
examples.zh: 我們用硬紙板做了一間模型屋。

examples.en: Please flatten the cardboard boxes before recycling them.
examples.zh: 請在回收前把硬紙板箱壓平。

examples.en: The sign was cut from a piece of cardboard.
examples.zh: 這塊告示牌是用一塊硬紙板剪成的。

examples.en: Honesty is a cardinal rule in our family.
examples.zh: 誠實是我們家的首要規則。

examples.en: Cardinal numbers, such as one and two, show quantity.
examples.zh: 基數，例如一和二，是用來表示數量的。

examples.en: Safety is the cardinal principle of this lab.
examples.zh: 安全是這間實驗室的首要原則。

examples.en: A cardinal sat on the fence outside the window.
examples.zh: 一隻紅雀停在窗外的柵欄上。

examples.en: The cardinal blessed the crowd in the square.
examples.zh: 紅衣主教在廣場上為群眾祝福。

examples.en: A cardinal is a high-ranking priest in the Catholic Church.
examples.zh: 紅衣主教是天主教會中的高階神職人員。

senses.zh: 無憂無慮的；漫不經心的

examples.en: The children spent a carefree summer at the beach.
examples.zh: 孩子們在海邊度過了無憂無慮的夏天。

examples.en: He has a carefree attitude toward money.
examples.zh: 他對金錢的態度很漫不經心。

examples.en: My grandparents enjoy a carefree life in the countryside.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母在鄉下過著無憂無慮的生活。

examples.en: The caretaker of the old building lives on the first floor.
examples.zh: 這棟老建築的管理員住在一樓。

examples.en: She works as a caretaker for an elderly man.
examples.zh: 她擔任一位老先生的照顧者。

examples.en: My aunt became the main caretaker of her sick mother.
examples.zh: 我阿姨成了她生病母親的主要照顧者。

examples.en: Please buy a carton of milk and a dozen eggs.
examples.zh: 請買一盒牛奶和一打雞蛋。

examples.en: He carried a carton of books up the stairs.
examples.zh: 他扛著一箱書爬上樓梯。

examples.en: Recycle the empty juice carton after you drink it.
examples.zh: 喝完果汁後，請把空紙盒回收。

examples.en: The flood was a catastrophe for the small village.
examples.zh: 洪水對這個小村莊來說是一場大災難。

examples.en: Missing the flight was a catastrophe for our travel plans.
examples.zh: 錯過班機對我們的旅遊計畫而言是場大災難。

examples.en: The plan ended in catastrophe when the power went out during the show.
examples.zh: 演出途中停電，使整個計畫以慘劇收場。

examples.en: A local restaurant will cater our school party.
examples.zh: 當地一家餐廳會為我們的校園派對承辦餐飲。

examples.en: The hotel can cater for up to two hundred guests.
examples.zh: 這間旅館最多能為兩百位客人提供餐飲服務。

examples.en: The store tries to cater to young shoppers.
examples.zh: 這家店努力迎合年輕顧客的需求。

examples.en: The dentist found a cavity in my back tooth.
examples.zh: 牙醫在我的後牙發現一顆蛀牙。

examples.en: Eating too much candy can cause cavities.
examples.zh: 吃太多糖果可能造成蛀牙。

examples.en: The chest cavity protects the heart and lungs.
examples.zh: 胸腔保護心臟和肺臟。

examples.en: Cut the celery into small pieces and add it to the soup.
examples.zh: 把芹菜切成小塊，加進湯裡。

examples.en: Celery sticks are a crunchy and healthy snack.
examples.zh: 芹菜條是爽脆又健康的點心。

examples.en: I do not like the strong smell of celery.
examples.zh: 我不喜歡芹菜的強烈氣味。

examples.en: Water boils at one hundred degrees Celsius.
examples.zh: 水在攝氏一百度時沸騰。

examples.en: The temperature dropped to five degrees Celsius last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚氣溫降到攝氏五度。

examples.en: Most weather reports in Taiwan use the Celsius scale.
examples.zh: 台灣大多數的天氣預報都使用攝氏溫標。

examples.en: The government takes a census every ten years.
examples.zh: 政府每十年進行一次人口普查。

examples.en: The census showed that the town's population had grown.
examples.zh: 人口普查顯示這個鎮的人口增加了。

examples.en: Census workers visited each home to collect information.
examples.zh: 普查人員逐戶拜訪以蒐集資料。

examples.en: She bought a ceramic bowl at the night market.
examples.zh: 她在夜市買了一個陶瓷碗。

examples.en: The ceramic tiles in the kitchen are easy to clean.
examples.zh: 廚房的陶瓷磁磚很容易清潔。

examples.en: This ceramic cup keeps tea warm for a long time.
examples.zh: 這個陶瓷杯能讓茶保溫很久。

examples.en: The doctor will certify that you are healthy enough to travel.
examples.zh: 醫師會證明你的健康狀況適合旅行。

examples.en: This label certifies that the coffee is organic.
examples.zh: 這個標章證明這款咖啡是有機的。

examples.en: The school will certify her as a swimming instructor.
examples.zh: 學校將認證她為游泳教練。

examples.en: They opened a bottle of champagne to celebrate the wedding.
examples.zh: 他們開了一瓶香檳慶祝婚禮。

examples.en: The waiter poured champagne into tall glasses.
examples.zh: 服務生把香檳倒進高腳杯。

examples.en: Champagne is often served at New Year's parties.
examples.zh: 香檳常在跨年派對上供應。

examples.en: The fans began to chant the name of their team.
examples.zh: 球迷開始齊聲喊出球隊的名字。

examples.en: Students chant the poem aloud to memorize it.
examples.zh: 學生大聲吟誦這首詩以便背誦。

examples.en: Children chant happily while they jump rope.
examples.zh: 孩子們一邊跳繩一邊開心地唱誦。

examples.en: The crowd's chant could be heard from outside the stadium.
examples.zh: 球場外都聽得到群眾的呼喊聲。

examples.en: The monks' chant filled the quiet temple.
examples.zh: 僧侶的誦經聲迴盪在寧靜的寺廟裡。

examples.en: The team's victory chant echoed down the street.
examples.zh: 球隊的勝利呼聲在街上迴盪。

examples.en: She made a charitable donation to the children's hospital.
examples.zh: 她對兒童醫院做了一筆慈善捐款。

examples.en: The charitable group collects winter coats for poor families.
examples.zh: 這個慈善團體為貧困家庭募集冬季外套。

examples.en: He is a charitable person who always gives others the benefit of the doubt.
examples.zh: 他為人寬厚，總是願意往好處想別人。

examples.en: I have a medical checkup next Monday.
examples.zh: 我下週一要做健康檢查。

examples.en: The dentist recommends a checkup every six months.
examples.zh: 牙醫建議每六個月檢查一次。

examples.en: Take your dog to the vet for a yearly checkup.
examples.zh: 帶你的狗去看獸醫，做年度健檢。

examples.en: Roasted chestnuts are a popular winter snack.
examples.zh: 烤栗子是受歡迎的冬季點心。

examples.en: She added chopped chestnuts to the cake.
examples.zh: 她在蛋糕中加入切碎的栗子。

examples.en: The horse had a shiny coat the color of chestnut.
examples.zh: 那匹馬有一身光亮的栗色毛皮。

examples.en: She has long chestnut hair.
examples.zh: 她有一頭栗色長髮。

examples.en: The chestnut horse ran across the field.
examples.zh: 那匹栗色的馬跑過原野。

examples.en: He painted the door a deep chestnut color.
examples.zh: 他把門漆成深栗色。

examples.en: The chimpanzee used a stick to reach the fruit.
examples.zh: 那隻黑猩猩用一根樹枝去搆水果。

examples.en: Chimpanzees live in groups in the forests of Africa.
examples.zh: 黑猩猩成群居住在非洲的森林裡。

examples.en: The children laughed when the chimpanzee waved at them at the zoo.
examples.zh: 黑猩猩在動物園向孩子們揮手，孩子們都笑了。

examples.en: Birds chirp in the trees early in the morning.
examples.zh: 清晨時，鳥兒在樹上啾啾鳴叫。

examples.en: The crickets chirp loudly on summer nights.
examples.zh: 蟋蟀在夏夜裡大聲鳴叫。

examples.en: The baby bird began to chirp when its mother returned.
examples.zh: 鳥媽媽回來時，小鳥開始啾啾叫。

examples.en: We heard the chirp of a bird outside the window.
examples.zh: 我們聽到窗外有鳥的鳴叫聲。

examples.en: A cricket's chirp kept me awake last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚蟋蟀的唧唧聲害我睡不著。

examples.en: The smoke alarm gave a short chirp when the battery was low.
examples.zh: 電池電量太低時，煙霧警報器發出短促的嗶聲。

examples.en: Too much fried food can raise your cholesterol.
examples.zh: 吃太多油炸食物會使你的膽固醇升高。

examples.en: The doctor checked my blood cholesterol level.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查了我的血中膽固醇濃度。

examples.en: Oats can help lower cholesterol.
examples.zh: 燕麥有助於降低膽固醇。

examples.en: We dug for clams on the beach at low tide.
examples.zh: 退潮時，我們在海灘上挖蛤蜊。

examples.en: She ordered a bowl of clam soup.
examples.zh: 她點了一碗蛤蜊湯。

examples.en: Fresh clams should open when you cook them.
examples.zh: 新鮮的蛤蜊煮熟後殼會打開。

examples.en: She clasped her mother's hand tightly in the crowd.
examples.zh: 在人群中，她緊緊握住媽媽的手。

examples.en: He clasped his hands together and made a wish.
examples.zh: 他雙手交握，許了一個願望。

examples.en: The little girl clasped the doll to her chest.
examples.zh: 小女孩把玩偶緊抱在胸前。

examples.en: The clasp on my necklace broke.
examples.zh: 我的項鍊扣環壞了。

examples.en: Please check the clasp before you wear the bracelet.
examples.zh: 戴手鍊前請檢查一下扣環。

examples.en: The bag closes with a metal clasp.
examples.zh: 這個包包用金屬扣環闔上。

examples.en: The store is having a clearance sale on winter clothes.
examples.zh: 商店正在舉辦冬季衣物清倉特賣。

examples.en: The pilot waited for clearance to land.
examples.zh: 飛行員等待降落許可。

examples.en: There was little clearance between the van and the wall.
examples.zh: 廂型車和牆壁之間幾乎沒有空隙。

examples.en: Turn the knob clockwise to increase the volume.
examples.zh: 把旋鈕順時針轉動以調大音量。

examples.en: The runners moved clockwise around the track.
examples.zh: 跑者們沿著跑道順時針前進。

examples.en: Stir the soup clockwise for one minute.
examples.zh: 把湯順時針攪拌一分鐘。

examples.en: Please move in a clockwise direction around the room.
examples.zh: 請朝順時針方向繞著房間移動。

examples.en: The fan blades make a clockwise rotation.
examples.zh: 風扇葉片做順時針旋轉。

examples.en: Follow the clockwise path around the lake.
examples.zh: 沿著環湖順時針方向的步道走。

examples.en: Scientists created a clone of a sheep many years ago.
examples.zh: 科學家多年前培育出一隻綿羊的複製體。

examples.en: This app is a clone of a popular game.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式是某款熱門遊戲的仿製品。

examples.en: The movie is about a girl who meets her own clone.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述一個女孩遇見自己的複製人。

examples.en: Scientists can clone cells in a laboratory.
examples.zh: 科學家可以在實驗室中複製細胞。

examples.en: You can clone the repository to your own computer.
examples.zh: 你可以把這個儲存庫複製到自己的電腦。

examples.en: The company tried to clone its rival's website.
examples.zh: 這家公司試圖仿造對手的網站。

examples.en: The closure of the bridge caused heavy traffic.
examples.zh: 橋梁封閉造成嚴重塞車。

examples.en: The store announced its closure after twenty years.
examples.zh: 這家商店在營業二十年後宣布歇業。

examples.en: Talking with her friend gave her a sense of closure.
examples.zh: 和朋友談過之後，她心裡得到了了結。

examples.en: Several parties formed a coalition to govern the country.
examples.zh: 數個政黨組成聯合政府來治理國家。

examples.en: A coalition of local groups is working to clean up the river.
examples.zh: 當地團體組成的聯盟正致力清理這條河。

examples.en: The coalition of teachers asked for smaller class sizes.
examples.zh: 教師聯盟要求縮小班級人數。

examples.en: The road follows the coastline for fifty kilometers.
examples.zh: 這條公路沿著海岸線延伸五十公里。

examples.en: Taiwan has a long and beautiful coastline.
examples.zh: 台灣有綿長又美麗的海岸線。

examples.en: Rising seas may change the coastline of small islands.
examples.zh: 海平面上升可能改變小島的海岸線。

examples.en: "Kids" is a colloquial word for children.
examples.zh: 「kids」是「孩子」的口語說法。

examples.en: The author uses colloquial language to sound friendly.
examples.zh: 作者使用口語化的語言，讓文字讀來親切。

examples.en: Colloquial expressions can be hard for learners to understand.
examples.zh: 口語表達對學習者來說可能很難理解。

examples.en: A bright comet will pass near the Earth next month.
examples.zh: 一顆明亮的彗星下個月將從地球附近經過。

examples.en: We stayed up late to watch the comet.
examples.zh: 我們熬夜看彗星。

examples.en: A comet has a long tail made of ice and dust.
examples.zh: 彗星有一條由冰和塵埃組成的長尾巴。

examples.en: Smartphones are now commonplace among teenagers.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機如今在青少年之間十分普遍。

examples.en: Traffic jams are commonplace on holiday weekends.
examples.zh: 假日週末塞車是司空見慣的事。

examples.en: Online shopping has become commonplace in many families.
examples.zh: 網路購物在許多家庭已經很普遍。

examples.en: Many former British colonies belong to the Commonwealth.
examples.zh: 許多前英國殖民地隸屬於大英國協。

examples.en: The leaders of the Commonwealth meet every few years.
examples.zh: 大英國協的領袖每隔幾年會面一次。

examples.en: Poland and Lithuania once formed a commonwealth.
examples.zh: 波蘭與立陶宛曾組成一個聯邦。

senses.zh: 健談的；善於溝通的；溝通式的

examples.en: My neighbor is a communicative old man who greets everyone.
examples.zh: 我的鄰居是個健談的老先生，會跟每個人打招呼。

examples.en: The communicative approach helps students speak English more confidently.
examples.zh: 溝通式教學法幫助學生更有自信地說英語。

examples.en: He is not very communicative in the morning.
examples.zh: 他早上不太愛說話。

examples.en: The hikers used a compass to find their way out of the forest.
examples.zh: 登山客用指南針找出走出森林的路。

examples.en: Draw a circle with a compass.
examples.zh: 用圓規畫一個圓。

examples.en: A compass always points toward magnetic north.
examples.zh: 指南針總是指向磁北。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to compile a list of our favorite books.
examples.zh: 老師要求我們彙整一份最愛的書單。

examples.en: Reporters compiled facts from several sources for the article.
examples.zh: 記者從幾個來源彙整事實寫成這篇報導。

examples.en: The software will compile the code in a few seconds.
examples.zh: 軟體會在幾秒內編譯這段程式碼。

examples.en: A light salad will complement the pasta well.
examples.zh: 清爽的沙拉與義大利麵很相配。

examples.en: Her calm style complements his energetic one.
examples.zh: 她沉穩的風格與他活力十足的風格相輔相成。

examples.en: The new curtains complement the color of the sofa.
examples.zh: 新窗簾與沙發的顏色很相配。

examples.en: The wine is a perfect complement to the cheese.
examples.zh: 這款酒是起司的絕佳搭配。

examples.en: This course is a useful complement to your regular classes.
examples.zh: 這門課是對你一般課程的有益補充。

examples.en: The team now has its full complement of players.
examples.zh: 球隊現在球員編制齊全。
